title: The price ghost
hook: Setty, on a felt pouf in an empty coworking at night, to the coach alone at the long table: You sent your [bleep]ing price in the DM, right?
biais: chiffre très précis (9 sur 10, la situation du lecteur)
pertinence pour soi (son « how much? » de la semaine)
cta: Comment SETTY (he sends everything to build your AI setter for free)
caption:
Comment "SETTY" and he'll send you everything to build a free AI setter that answers the price question for you. Follow so the DM lands 📩

👇 READ BELOW: why leads ghost right after "how much is it?", and the reply that keeps them talking.

1. The lead asks the price, you send a number, and the chat ends on "Seen". Dropping the price won't change that.

2. Without context, a price is just a number: they don't know yet what it fixes for them. Saying no feels awkward, so they disappear instead.

3. Give the price, plus one question about them: what made you reach out today? If they go quiet, nudge them a few hours later. Sometimes they just got busy and forgot.

4. Setty is the AI setter I built for coaches: through Manychat, he answers the price from your offer, asks the next question, and follows up to 3 times inside the 24-hour window.

The catch: no reply can save an offer that doesn't fit, and no tool can promise a number of calls. Building and testing Setty are free with no card, then going live starts a 14-day trial at $119/month per live setter.
